// diagnostic

E0747

This callback uses the effect `{effect_name}`, which the parameter doesn't allow.

What

This callback uses the effect `{effect_name}`, which the parameter doesn't allow.

Why

A `fn(…) -[]>` parameter demands a pure callback, and a `fn(…) -[E]>` parameter bounds the callback to the listed effects; the actual callback's inferred effects must be a subset. The bound is checked at the call site, so an impure callback is rejected before it runs.

Fix

Pass a callback within the bound (a `fn … -[]>` for a pure parameter), or widen the parameter's effect bound.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0747: tests/ui/callback_value_reaches_denied_panic.stderr.

Error [jet.CallbackEffectBoundExceeded]: This callback uses the effect `Panic`, which the parameter doesn't allow
  --> tests/ui/callback_value_reaches_denied_panic.jet:9:22
    |
  9 |     c: stop_apply(4, noisy)
    |                      ^^^^^
 Why: The parameter is `fn(…) -[!Panic]>`, which denies `Panic`
 Fix: Pass a callback that can't reach `Panic`, or remove the denial from the parameter's row
 Denial: invocation
